results.note: Earlier than the wiki Haki section's first citation (ch 264-265); Mantra is Skypiea's name for Observation Haki, so a reader at ch 251 sees the ability but not the later 'Haki' terminology.

haki.evidence: Kizaru, Aokiji and Akainu combine emitted Haki to disperse Whitebeard's quake shockwave, ch 564.
Kizaru senses Jaygarcia Saturn's arrival on Egghead, ch 1094.

results.note: The ch 564 shield is only retroactively labelled advanced Armament Haki; the on-page text there just calls it Haki. Observation is otherwise Vivre Card-only before 1094.

haki.evidence: Flashback clash of Harald's Supreme King Haki with Rocks D. Xebec's, knocking out everyone within five kilometers, ch 1155.

haki.evidence: Jinbe hardens his arms to defend against the Big Mom Pirates, ch 864.
Jinbe senses the burst of Shanks' Supreme King Haki from Wano, ch 1055.
At Marineford Koby involuntarily hears the combatants' presences vanish as they die, ch 579.
Koby shatters Avalo Pizarro's island hand with a Haki-infused Honesty Impact, ch 1088.

results.note: Observation is displayed at 579 but only named as Haki at 594, when Dr. Fishbonen explains it; use 594 instead if the filter should key on the naming.

haki.evidence: Garp punches and hurts Marco despite his regenerative phoenix form, ch 567.
Garp's Galaxy Impact shows Supreme King Haki infused into his fist as black lightning, ch 1080.
Dr. Fishbonen states all vice admirals use Haki and points Koby to Garp to master his new Observation Haki, ch 594.

results.note: The unambiguous Haki-vs-Haki Armament feat is the Chinjao flashback at ch 719; 567 is the earliest published display. Garp's clearest Observation display (catching invisible Shiryu's strike) is ch 1087.

haki.evidence: Awakened Lucci hardens his fists and clashes with Luffy, ch 1069 p10-11.
Lucci senses Jaygarcia Saturn's arrival on Egghead, ch 1094.

results.note: Armament is one chapter earlier than the scraped hint (1070, the Sentomaru feat).

haki.evidence: Shanks drives off the Lord of the Coast with a single glare, ch 1.
Shanks senses a 'weird presence' (Ryokugyu) from miles outside Wano, ch 1054.
Shanks blocks Akainu's magma fist with Haki-imbued Gryphon to save Koby, ch 579.

results.note: The ch 1 glare is a display before Haki is named; it is explicitly confirmed as Supreme King Haki at ch 570 (and shown knocking out Whitebeard's crew at ch 434) if a stricter threshold is wanted.
